data.narrative: Suspicious activity report generated in response to unauthorized access and potential exfiltration of sensitive customer data (SSN, DOB, account details) from internal system store FM2. Customer CUST-99881 (Jennifer Martinez) associated with account ACC-70921. No fraudulent transactions observed; however, data integrity breach detected during post-investigation reporting phase. Account frozen pending investigation. No monetary loss identified at time of filing. Internal alert ALT-2026-05001 created with P1 priority. External fraud database checks returned no matches. Document verification confirmed authenticity of KYC documents. No suspicious network patterns identified via graph analysis. Incident classified as cross-phase data exfiltration with potential identity fraud exposure.

data.narrative: Suspicious transaction identified on account ACC-70921 belonging to Jennifer Martinez (CUST-99881). Transaction TXN-8891273 for $5,525.00 triggered fraud detection rule FRD-101 (Baseline Deviation) due to amount exceeding 90-day average by 1.3x. Customer profile indicates low risk rating, verified KYC, and no prior SARs. External fraud database check on SSN 321-54-9876 returned clear. Document verification of driver's license (DOC-7721-KYC) confirmed authenticity. Graph analysis showed no suspicious network patterns. Account was frozen (FRZ-2026-07001) and chargeback initiated (CB-2026-03001) under Reg E reason code 10.4 (fraud). SAR filed per BSA requirements following confirmation of unauthorized activity. No PEP or sanctions flags detected.
